raw_text:
FIGURE REVIEW of r-20261105T160605201635-coil-edit-panels-on-solve-currents at d559d30a96d786f1c35b670d0d8da954a3dd854e from base e7df23944b989ff71508e0eb83552305d94979a3.

The five repository PNGs named in this record are byte-identical to one another (md5 3aced6c991929100c3f2ba87a8a66598, 1484x644) and the five run-directory attachments (image-1/3/5/7/9.png) are byte-identical to one another (md5 8e886777ab82df0c34cf88dfdfe69f55, 1400x608). Two renders serve five published paths, so this review judges one rendered artifact.

What the render shows: two poloidal panels side by side, axes off. Left title 'edit 12 +6% residual 5.730e-09 converged yes trips 3'; right title 'edit 9 +0% residual 6.612e-03 converged no trips 3'. Each panel draws the MAST first wall in black, the reference flux in pale grey-blue #9aa4b2 at the same shared levels, the solved flux in orange #cc7722, an assembled separatrix lobe as a solid curve with two dashed legs, and both null sets: blue #3366cc reference and orange solved, admitted saddle filled and other qualified nulls hollow. The converged panel's orange and blue sets coincide; the non-converged panel's orange lobe and legs sit visibly off the blue reference, which is the comparison the figure exists to make and it reads immediately. Above the panels, a single six-line centred caption carries the level range, the vertical-centre row, the saddle positions, the branch style, 'wall drawn', and both panels' map spacing, node mismatches, promoted counts and nearest distances.

RUBRIC legibility: the panels are legible at a glance and the converged/non-converged difference is visible; the caption is drawn at fontsize 9 and renders at about 5.5 pt in the ~900 px reckon column, so the numbers cannot be read at page scale (blocking, benchmarks/coil_edit_latency.py:2410).
RUBRIC data_ink: the contours, wall and separatrix carry the weight; the caption spends ~20 per cent of the canvas height on prose.
RUBRIC decoration: no gradient, background fill, shading or frame; the axes are off.
RUBRIC contrast: black text on white; #3366cc measures 5.4:1 and #cc7722 3.4:1 against white, both clear of 3:1; the grey-blue reference contours at 2.5:1 are the recessive comparison series by design.
RUBRIC table_form: a spatial poloidal comparison; nothing here is naturally a table.
RUBRIC label_collision: zero clipped and zero overlapping labels measured on the render (caption ink columns 51-1432 of 1484, panel titles 45-1424 with a 109-pixel gap, data below row 230); the one occlusion is the reference's hollow axis marker under the solved filled marker.

FINDING benchmarks/coil_edit_latency.py:2410 (blocking): the caption carrying every number a reader needs is drawn at fontsize 9 into a 10.6 x 4.6 inch canvas at 140 dpi (1484 x 644 px), about 5.5 pt at page width, below the 14 pt direct-label and 16 pt axis-label floors this repository sets.
FINDING docs/figures/forward-solve-api/coil-edit-nonconvergence/coil-edit-nonconvergence.html (non-blocking): the page caption still names edit 2 / edit 7 with residuals 4.129e-09 Wb and 6.514e-03 Wb and sixteen trips, while the redrawn image's titles read edit 12 / edit 9 with 5.730e-09 Wb and 6.612e-03 Wb and three trips; the html is outside the run's changed paths.
FINDING benchmarks/coil_edit_latency.py:2178 (non-blocking): the solved null set is painted over the reference set, so at the axis the filled orange triangle covers the hollow blue one and the caption's both-null-sets promise cannot be checked there.
reviewed_paths_revision_note: judged at d559d30a96d786f1c35b670d0d8da954a3dd854e; the figure PNGs for all five paths changed in this run per git diff --stat e7df23944b98..d559d30a96d7

rubric_verdicts.contrast: text is pure black on white; the two data hues measure 5.4:1 (#3366cc blue) and 3.4:1 (#cc7722 orange) against white, both clear of the 3:1 line floor, and the recessive reference contours (#9aa4b2, 2.5:1) are the deliberate grey of the comparison series rather than a legibility failure.
rubric_verdicts.data_ink: the data carry the weight. The flux contours are the bulk of the ink, the wall is a thin closure, and there is no legend box or furniture competing with them; the caption prose spends about 20 per cent of the canvas height on text, which is the one place ink is spent on something other than data.
rubric_verdicts.decoration: no gradient, no background fill, no shading and no frame; the panels are white with line work only, and the style's despine rule is met because the axes are off entirely.
rubric_verdicts.label_collision: nothing is clipped and no text crosses text or data: the caption block occupies columns 51-1432 of a 1484-wide canvas and rows 7-133, the two panel titles occupy columns 45-1424 with a 109-pixel gap between them, and the plotted data begins below row 230. The one occlusion is inside the panels rather than between labels: the reference's hollow axis marker is painted over by the solved filled axis marker at the same point.
rubric_verdicts.legibility: the panels themselves are legible at a glance: the wall, both separatrix sets and both null sets can be told apart in both panels, and the non-converged panel's off-set lobe and legs are immediately visible. The explanatory text is not: the six-line caption is drawn at fontsize 9 inside the image and renders at about 5.5 pt in the reckon column, so the only place the panel's numbers appear cannot be read at page scale.
rubric_verdicts.table_form: the image is a spatial poloidal comparison of two solved states against a reference; nothing in it is naturally a table, and the scalar numbers it carries are supportive of the geometry rather than the subject.
